idea: A red square tumbles across an empty page while the page says hello, first in Chinese and then in English.
leave: A blank page can greet you back.
subject: the page, from blank to greeting

device.what: a red square that rolls along the bottom edge from left to right for the whole film
device.why: its trip across the page is the film's clock, so the viewer feels the greeting arrive on time

change.from: bare cream paper with a red square at the lower left
change.to: the square has started to roll to the right

change.from: the square rolling on an empty page
change.to: 你好，翻页书 has risen into place and the square has rolled to the middle of the page

change.from: the Chinese greeting above the square at mid-page
change.to: Hello, flipbook sits under it and the square has rolled to the lower right
